export const CATALOGS: Readonly<Record<GameLocale, GameCatalog>> = {
  en: EN,
  es: ES
}

export const gameLocaleOf = (value: string | null | undefined): GameLocale => {
  const said = value?.trim().toLowerCase()
  return GAME_LOCALES.find((one) => one === said) ?? 'en'
}

export const stringsOf = (locale: GameLocale): GameStrings => {
  const catalog = CATALOGS[locale]
  return { text: { ...EN.text, ...catalog.text }, art: { ...EN.art, ...catalog.art } }
}

// Why these ranges: Latin with accents, punctuation, box drawing and blocks, ★ and card suits.
const isRasterCode = (code: number): boolean =>
  (code >= 0x20 && code < 0x7f) ||
  (code >= 0xa0 && code < 0x300) ||
  (code >= 0x2010 && code <= 0x2027) ||
  (code >= 0x2500 && code <= 0x25ff) ||
  code === 0x2605 ||
  (code >= 0x2660 && code <= 0x2667)

export const isRasterText = (text: string): boolean =>
  [...text].every((one) => isRasterCode(one.codePointAt(0) ?? 0))

const INVISIBLE = /[\p{M}\p{Cc}\p{Cf}︀-️]/u

/** Text as a Raster can draw it: invisible marks dropped, anything wider or unknown shown as `?`. */
export const rasterGlyphsOf = (text: string): string[] =>
  [...text.normalize('NFC')].flatMap((one) =>
    INVISIBLE.test(one) ? [] : isRasterCode(one.codePointAt(0) ?? 0) ? [one] : ['?']
  )

let activeLocale: GameLocale = 'en'
let active: GameStrings = EN

// Set once per session from ORCA_GAME_LOCALE, before anything is drawn.
export const setGameLocale = (locale: GameLocale): void => {
  activeLocale = locale
  active = stringsOf(locale)
}

export const gameStrings = (): GameStrings => active

export const gameLocale = (): GameLocale => activeLocale

export const localizedNameOf = (name: LocalizedName, locale = activeLocale): string =>
  typeof name === 'string' ? name : (name[locale] ?? name.en)

import type { GameCi, GameLocale, GameReview } from '../types'
import { stringsOf } from './game-strings'
import { ES_STATE_REPORT } from './state-report-words-es'

/** A member as the lead's fleet sees it, the way `orca game fleet` names the phases. */
export type MemberPhase = 'needs-you' | 'limited' | 'working' | 'idle' | 'finished'

/** The words of `/orca-game:state`'s report. */
export type StateReportWords = {
  title: string
  mode: string
  scene: string
  render: string
  timezone: string
  lead: string
  warnings: string
  links: string
  /** The layer a value came from, as `orca game state` names it. */
  from: (source: string) => string
  sceneFile: (path: string) => string
  /** `command` is the game command that set it for this session. */
  thisSession: (value: string, command: string) => string
  hud: (on: boolean) => string
  rewards: (on: boolean) => string
  tracker: (on: boolean) => string
  leadsHere: (label: string | undefined) => string
  memberHere: (label: string | undefined) => string
  slots: (used: number, cap: number) => string
  noMembers: string
  phases: Readonly<Record<MemberPhase, string>>
  stop: (since: string | null, by: string | null) => string
  stopUnreadable: string
  reviewStates: Readonly<Record<GameReview['state'], string>>
  ciWords: Readonly<Record<GameCi, string>>
  notGamePane: string
  notState: string
  failed: (reason: string) => string
}

export type StateReportCatalog = Omit<StateReportWords, 'reviewStates' | 'ciWords'>

const onOff = (on: boolean): string => (on ? 'on' : 'off')

export const EN_STATE_REPORT: StateReportCatalog = {
  title: 'Agent Teams game',
  mode: 'Mode',
  scene: 'Scene',
  render: 'Render',
  timezone: 'Timezone',
  lead: 'Lead',
  warnings: 'Warnings',
  links: 'Links',
  from: (source) => `(from ${source})`,
  sceneFile: (path) => `scene file ${path}`,
  thisSession: (value, command) => `this session: ${value} (/${command})`,
  hud: (on) => `HUD ${onOff(on)}`,
  rewards: (on) => `rewards ${onOff(on)}`,
  tracker: (on) => `tracker ${onOff(on)}`,
  leadsHere: (label) => (label ? `${label}, this pane` : 'this pane'),
  memberHere: (label) =>
    label
      ? `${label} · this pane is a member and reports to it`
      : 'this pane is a member and reports to its lead',
  slots: (used, cap) => `${used} of ${cap} slots used, ${Math.max(0, cap - used)} free`,
  noMembers: 'no members yet',
  phases: {
    'needs-you': 'needs you',
    limited: 'limited',
    working: 'working',
    idle: 'idle',
    finished: 'finished'
  },
  stop: (since, by) =>
    `STOP${since ? ` since ${since}` : ''}${by ? ` (by ${by})` : ''}: nothing is launched or pushed until \`game resume\``,
  stopUnreadable: 'STOP (its state cannot be read, so it counts as set)',
  notGamePane:
    "This session was not started by Orca's game: ORCA_GAME_CLI is not set, so there is no game state to show. Open a Claude Agent Teams pane from Orca.",
  notState: 'orca game state answered something that is not a game state',
  failed: (reason) => `orca game state failed: ${reason}`
}

export const stateReportWordsOf = (locale: GameLocale): StateReportWords => {
  const { reviewStates, ciWords } = stringsOf(locale).text
  const catalog = locale === 'es' ? ES_STATE_REPORT : EN_STATE_REPORT
  return { ...catalog, reviewStates, ciWords }
}

    provider: 'github',
    number: 901,
    title: 'demo: scripted pull request',
    url: 'https://example.invalid/demo/901',
    state: step.merged === true ? 'merged' : 'open',
    ci: step.ci
  },
  workItem: {
    provider: 'plane',
    identifier: 'ORCA-1',
    title: 'Demo work item',
    url: 'https://example.invalid/demo/ORCA-1',
    status: step.group === 'done' ? 'Done' : step.group === 'review' ? 'In Review' : 'In Progress',
    statusGroup: step.group
  },
  project: projectOf(step),
  actions: DEMO_ACTIONS
})

export const demoFrameOf = (step: number): DemoFrame => {
  const at = ((step % SCRIPT.length) + SCRIPT.length) % SCRIPT.length
  const frame = SCRIPT[at] ?? SCRIPT[0]
  const before = SCRIPT[(at + SCRIPT.length - 1) % SCRIPT.length] ?? frame
  if (frame === undefined || before === undefined) {
    throw new Error('the demo script is empty')
  }
  return {
    state: stateOf(frame),
    xp: frame.xp,
    phase: frame.phase,
    action: frame.action,
    caption: frame.caption(gameStrings().art),
    isResting: frame.isResting === true,
    isLevelUp: at !== 0 && levelOf(frame.xp).level > levelOf(before.xp).level
  }
}

import type { GameConfig, GameRender, GameSources } from '../types'
import { advisorSpriteOf } from './advisor-art'
import { advisorPoseAt, isAdvisorActingAt } from './advisor-state'
import { demoFrameOf, type DemoFrame } from './demo'
import { DEFAULT_GAME_CONFIG, effectiveConfigOf, isAbsorbingConfig } from './game-config'
import { daylightAt, hourOf, NOON, type Daylight } from './hd-daylight'
import type { TeamEvent } from './hd-overlay'
import type { HdMember, March } from './hd-party'
import type { LeadState } from './lead-state'
import type { Action, FlowPhase } from './quest-policy'
import { isReacting, type Reaction } from './scene'
import { sceneOf, type SceneDefinition, type ScenePhase } from './scenes/index'

export type Animated = {
  key: string
  columns: number
  rows: number
  draw: (tick: number) => string
}

/** A spinner scene on screen: the size and render its Raster was drawn with. */
export type Stage = { columns: number; rows: number; render: GameRender }

type QuestRuntime = {
  envConfig: GameConfig
  liveConfig: Partial<GameConfig>
  liveSources: GameSources
  modeOverride: GameConfig['mode'] | undefined
  renderOverride: GameRender | undefined
  tick: number
  phase: FlowPhase | undefined
  fleetPhase: FlowPhase | undefined
  alert: string
  isDone: boolean
  action: Action | undefined
  isDemo: boolean
  demoStep: number
  demoAt: number
  caption: string
  captionAt: number
  reaction: { kind: Reaction['kind']; at: number } | undefined
  notes: Set<string>
  replies: Set<string>
  stages: Map<string, Stage>
  animations: Map<string, readonly Animated[]>
  cardPhases: Map<string, ScenePhase>
  /** The time hd's day and night read, sampled from `$.clock`; 0 until the first sample. */
  clockMs: number
  hdParty: readonly HdMember[]
  isHdPartySeen: boolean
  leavers: readonly HdMember[]
  marches: ReadonlyMap<string, March>
  lead: string | undefined
  /** This pane's own state as the lead; undefined in a member's pane or before the first refresh. */
  leadState: LeadState | undefined
  event: { kind: TeamEvent['kind']; text: string; at: number } | undefined
}

// Module state: a hot reload starts it over, which only costs the scene its current pose.
export const quest: QuestRuntime = {
  envConfig: DEFAULT_GAME_CONFIG,
  liveConfig: {},
  liveSources: {},
  modeOverride: undefined,
  renderOverride: undefined,
  tick: 0,
  phase: undefined,
  fleetPhase: undefined,
  alert: '',
  isDone: false,
  action: undefined,
  isDemo: false,
  demoStep: 0,
  demoAt: 0,
  caption: '',
  captionAt: 0,
  reaction: undefined,
  notes: new Set<string>(),
  replies: new Set<string>(),
  stages: new Map<string, Stage>(),
  animations: new Map<string, readonly Animated[]>(),
  cardPhases: new Map<string, ScenePhase>(),
  clockMs: 0,
  hdParty: [],
  isHdPartySeen: false,
  leavers: [],
  marches: new Map<string, March>(),
  lead: undefined,
  leadState: undefined,
  event: undefined
}

export const gameConfig = (): GameConfig =>
  effectiveConfigOf(quest.envConfig, quest.liveConfig, quest.modeOverride, quest.renderOverride)

/** The config without this session's /quest overrides: what Orca's layers and the launch env say. */
export const configuredConfig = (): GameConfig =>
  effectiveConfigOf(quest.envConfig, quest.liveConfig, undefined)

export const currentScene = (): SceneDefinition => sceneOf(gameConfig().scene)

export const demoNow = (): DemoFrame => demoFrameOf(quest.demoStep)

export const shownPhase = (): FlowPhase | undefined =>
  quest.isDemo ? demoNow().phase : (quest.phase ?? quest.fleetPhase)

export const shownCaption = (): string => {
  if (quest.isDemo) {
    return demoNow().caption
  }
  return quest.caption === '' ? quest.alert : quest.caption
}

// Why not isDone for a lead: moving tickets and merging is how it orchestrates, not a finish.
export const shownResting = (): boolean => {
  if (quest.isDemo) {
    return demoNow().isResting
  }
  return quest.leadState === undefined ? quest.isDone : quest.leadState === 'sleeping'
}

export const shownAction = (): Action | undefined =>
  quest.isDemo ? demoNow().action : quest.action

export const reactionAt = (tick: number): Reaction | undefined =>
  quest.reaction === undefined
    ? undefined
    : { kind: quest.reaction.kind, age: tick - quest.reaction.at }

export const isSceneShown = (): boolean => quest.stages.size > 0

export const isClawdReacting = (): boolean => isReacting(reactionAt(quest.tick))

/** The advisor acts something out now, so the band shows the scene when no spinner does. */
export const isAdvisorActing = (): boolean =>
  gameConfig().mode !== 'off' &&
  isAdvisorActingAt(quest.tick, gameConfig().mode === 'zen', isAbsorbingConfig(gameConfig()))

/** hd's light now, on the project's timezone; noon until the clock is first read. */
export const daylightNow = (): Daylight =>
  quest.clockMs === 0 ? NOON : daylightAt(hourOf(quest.clockMs, gameConfig().timezone))

export const teamEventAt = (tick: number): TeamEvent | undefined =>
  quest.event === undefined
    ? undefined
    : { kind: quest.event.kind, text: quest.event.text, age: tick - quest.event.at }

/** The caption is the alert of a teammate waiting on the person. */
export const isAlertShown = (): boolean =>
  !quest.isDemo && quest.caption === '' && quest.alert !== ''

// Why absorbing: while the game is not drawing Jev's lines, Jev draws its own; only Claude's calls show.
export const advisorShownAt = (tick: number) =>
  advisorPoseAt(
    tick,
    advisorSpriteOf(currentScene()),
    gameConfig().mode === 'zen',
    isAbsorbingConfig(gameConfig())
  )

import type { HdMember } from './hd-party'
import { partyOf } from './party'
import { cellsOf } from './pixel-canvas'
import {
  advisorShownAt,
  currentScene,
  daylightNow,
  demoNow,
  gameConfig,
  isAlertShown,
  quest,
  teamEventAt,
  reactionAt,
  shownAction,
  shownCaption,
  shownPhase,
  shownResting,
  type Animated,
  type Stage
} from './quest-state'
import { SCENE_ROWS, sceneCellsOf } from './scene'
import { hdRowsOf, hdSceneGridOf } from './scene-hd'

// What each Raster the game owns draws on a tick: the spinner's scene in its render, and the band's pet.

/** The spinner's stage for this width and terminal height, in the render the session draws now. */
export const stageOf = (columns: number, viewportRows?: number): Stage =>
  gameConfig().render === 'hd'
    ? { columns, rows: hdRowsOf(viewportRows), render: 'hd' }
    : { columns, rows: SCENE_ROWS, render: 'classic' }

const demoPartyOf = (hasRewards: boolean): HdMember[] =>
  partyOf(demoNow().state, hasRewards).map((one) => ({
    key: one.key,
    phase: one.phase,
    state: one.state
  }))

// Why the stage's render: a blit between a /quest render flip and the next ui.render keeps the Raster's rows.
export const stageCellsOf = (stage: Stage): string => {
  const since = quest.isDemo ? quest.demoAt : quest.captionAt
  if (stage.render === 'hd') {
    return cellsOf(
      hdSceneGridOf({
        scene: currentScene(),
        phase: shownPhase(),
        columns: stage.columns,
        rows: stage.rows,
        tick: quest.tick,
        caption: shownCaption(),
        since,
        reaction: reactionAt(quest.tick),
        isResting: shownResting(),
        action: shownAction(),
        advisor: advisorShownAt(quest.tick),
        isWaiting: isAlertShown(),
        light: daylightNow(),
        party: quest.isDemo ? demoPartyOf(gameConfig().rewards) : quest.hdParty,
        leavers: quest.isDemo ? [] : quest.leavers,
        marches: quest.isDemo ? new Map() : quest.marches,
        lead: quest.isDemo ? undefined : quest.lead,
        event: teamEventAt(quest.tick)
      })
    )
  }
  return sceneCellsOf(
    currentScene(),
    shownPhase(),
    stage.columns,
    quest.tick,
    shownCaption(),
    since,
    reactionAt(quest.tick),
    shownResting(),
    shownAction(),
    advisorShownAt(quest.tick)
  ).cells
}

// Why classic: the band holds 8 rows at most, so its scene stays the 5-row art in either render.
export const petScene = (key: string, columns: number): Animated => ({
  key,
  columns,
  rows: SCENE_ROWS,
  draw: (at) =>
    sceneCellsOf(
      currentScene(),
      shownPhase(),
      columns,
      at,
      '',
      -Infinity,
      reactionAt(at),
      shownResting(),
      shownAction(),
      advisorShownAt(at)
    ).cells
})
